t2.thesis: MXL guided to a huge sequential ramp to $210-220M; a roughly 28% pullback from early-October highs has partly reset expectations, but a buy-side bar of 'beat and raise above consensus' plus weak AI-chip sentiment leaves the overnight reaction close to a coin flip with slight semis-cluster downside skew.
reasons: Semis cluster base rate (0.479) is below 50%, and the overall AMC base rate is only 0.538
Stock is down about 28% from $105.93 (Oct 2) to about $76, with 1m -13% and -41% from the 52w high, so some of the froth has been removed
Q3 guide implied about +27% QoQ; the 90-day EPS revision of +48% means the bar has risen, and the last print (beat plus strong guide) still opened -3.7%
Sector tape is negative: chip stocks are sliding on AI capex worries, and CRDO/ALAB peers are weak
Options imply about a 26% move with roughly flat skew, so there is no directional tell from positioning
t2.deciding_variable: Q4 revenue guide vs the buy-side whisper, specifically whether optical/Keystone 800G data-center revenue keeps accelerating and 1.6T timing holds.

prior.from: I3 by_cluster semis t0_hit 0.479 (MXL is an optical DSP / broadband semiconductor), nudged slightly toward overall 0.541 and AMC 0.538 because MXL also has ai_infra exposure (0.558)

t2.leak_probe: I don't know. MaxLinear's (MXL) earnings report is dated today, 2026-10-22, which is after my knowledge cutoff, so I have no information on how the stock reacted.
t2.moved_from_prior: Net roughly 0: the pullback and reset expectations (+2pts) are offset by negative sector momentum and a high buy-side bar after a 330% 12m run (-2pts); I stay at about 0.49.

theses.mechanism: Q3 lands at or above $220M and the Q4 guide implies continued double-digit QoQ growth in infrastructure; the de-rated stock squeezes higher
theses.wrong_if: The Q4 guide is flat-to-down sequentially or optical growth decelerates

theses.mechanism: In-line Q3 with a Q4 guide below the high bar set by a 4x run; holders sell into AI-capex worries, as happened after the July beat
theses.wrong_if: Management raises the 2027 data-center outlook or names new hyperscaler wins

theses.mechanism: Lumpy hyperscaler ordering or inventory digestion at module makers causes a cautious tone or a gross-margin miss
theses.wrong_if: Gross margin holds at about 59-61% with commentary of supply-constrained demand

key_observations: Q3 revenue vs the $210-220M guide and the 0.56 EPS consensus
Q4 revenue guide vs consensus (implied sequential growth)
Infrastructure/optical revenue growth and Keystone 800G ramp commentary
1.6T product sampling/production timing and hyperscaler concentration
Non-GAAP gross margin and opex discipline; any Silicon Motion arbitration update
Pre-print drift during the Oct 22 session given semis tape
